statistical_unit: Object; each primary object requires all three paired seeds and all three arms.
scope: Locked method-unused, geometry-screened cohort. No speed claim from shared-GPU runs; no automatic manuscript promotion.
nonfinite_policy: Keep exact-match objects. Primary mean-view PSNR contrast is undefined if nonfinite; pooled PSNR and MSE are uniform companions, not replacements. Null plus exact-match/nonfinite flags denotes a nonfinite metric.
